cityEdition: El Viejo San Juan: EUC Thrills by VibezZzCoder — https://github.com/VibezZzCoder/euc-sanjuan
note: Officer Dorkins and booking code adapted from the San Francisco edition of EUC Thrills (MIT, VibezZzCoder; several of these files were first written for the New York edition). The officer's look, paddle and sirens are EUC Thrills' own generated NPC assets already in js/euc/ and audio/euc/ (see NOTICE-EUC-THRILLS.md). Each entry records a San Juan file, the donor files with their bytes and SHA-256 at the recorded commit (identical in the listed public release), and the San Juan file's hash; tests/dorkins.test.mjs checks the San Juan hashes.

files.derived: The hover-wheel rig (generated cop look and standard machine, hover ring, field, pods, exhaust, emissive light bar), the ground contact shadow, out-of-view spawn behind the rider, the checked departure, the per-frame chase loop and the officer as booking presenter. Not taken: the searchlight (no light is added), the MRT shadow node, SF's road graph. San Juan's own: open-sky, recent-arrival and desk exclusions for spawns, the skate-spot gate, the Pause switch, the chase notice, the map marker, ?cop=0.

The kinematic flight brain (pursuit, route following with turn-limited speed, swoop, departure, search anchors). Changed: route planning spread over frames under a 1 ms budget, probes at 20 Hz, a route link the checked flight cannot follow is blocked; the SF road-graph builder is not taken.

The bounded A* with reusable typed scratch and the nearest-node lookup. The graph itself is San Juan's own: a typed view over the walk network and the traffic lane graph with checked joins, components and a resumable, cached search.

Support, sight and swept-volume flight queries. Added: the where-he-may-be rule (dry, inside the world, not closed ground, west of the east fence) at every sample, and a cheaper corridor check for route links.
Last-seen memory and search anchors, unchanged in behaviour.
Swept paddle contact admitted through the rider controller's hardKnock, unchanged in behaviour.
The chase referee and the notice's text model. Changed: San Juan's intervals (40-75 s, then 75-150 s), the skate-spot gate, the patrol switch and the San Juan wording.
Paddle timing and swept contact maths, unchanged.

Siren crossfade and range curve, settle and ducking, the sting, the hum and the paddle cues. Changed: no graph while he is away (buffers only), a low-pass on the siren, a lower settle, a paper-tear cue, a deterministic noise buffer.
The booking director (clock, transfer retry, phases) and the ordered checked placement. Changed: the site (La Princesa forecourt), the San Juan wording.

The booking host: one owner for clock, input and release; held keys cannot press a dialog button; the clock stops while blurred or hidden. Changed: the host state 'booking', the gamepad through San Juan's menu scheme, the plaque canvas, the native dialog markup in index.html.

The desk group, the tearing form, the officer presenting and the cinematic camera. Changed: the desk's paint and lamp, the free-standing plaque instead of the INTAKE sign, the camera framing around the dialog; no light.
